clean.operation: Collect dropped items in the marked area. Reserved player drops stay protected.

picker.operation: Gather dropped items and deliver them to a linked output.

lumberjack.operation: Cut logs with the tool in slot 1; deliver the actual drops.

planter.operation: Plant supplied seeds, carrots and potatoes on empty farmland.

leafcutter.operation: Trim leaves using the tool in slot 1 and collect their actual drops.

carrier.operation: Carry items from the linked input face to the linked output face.

fluid_carrier.operation: Transport fluid between linked tank faces. Internal capacity: 16 buckets.

bomber.operation: Consume gunpowder from slot 1 to damage nearby hostiles. Never damages terrain or players.

knight.operation: Defend the marked area against hostiles. Respects claims and combat protections.

miner.operation: Mine tagged ores with a suitable, charged tool in slot 1.

farmer.operation: Till exposed dirt or grass using a hoe in slot 1.

harvester.operation: Harvest mature crops and collect their drops. A planter supplies replacement seeds.

shovelman.operation: Excavate shovel-mineable blocks with the tool in slot 1.

butcher.operation: Cull adult farm animals in the marked area. Tamed animals and players are excluded.

builder.operation: Fit a printed Jugcraft blueprint in slot 1. Builds north from the linked anchor using cargo materials.

crafter.operation: Top nine cargo slots are a real crafting grid; finished items and remainders use the bottom rows.

delivery.operation: Deliver only the item type shown in slot 1; an empty filter accepts every type.

pump.operation: Pump source water or lava into the finite internal tank and a linked fluid output.

stripes.operation: Place supplied building blocks into empty supported cells of the marked area.

breaker.operation: Break ordinary blocks in the marked area. Never breaks block entities or unbreakable blocks.
